confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two web searches. The first returned the RBA rate and the second returned crowdsourced Gothenburg price ranges: cheap meal 120-150 SEK, cappuccino 35-50 SEK, draft beer 60-80 SEK, restaurant wine 60-100 SEK. These sources disagree with each other, and I converted SEK to USD at roughly 9.5 SEK per USD, which is an assumption. The three-course meal for two is an estimate: the sources gave 600-1,000 SEK, and I took about 900 SEK. The cocktail price is not from a source; I set it at roughly twice the beer price. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for July (peak season) and were not checked against any listings. I did not search for them.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gothenburg is comparable to Stockholm, but a little cheaper, and to Copenhagen and Oslo, which are somewhat more expensive. Swedish restaurant and alcohol prices are high, and alcohol is taxed heavily.
